fields.description: Breez is a furnished waterfront residential tower in Dubai Maritime City. Its homes include compact apartments, larger pool layouts and the separately marketed Breez Villa collection. Shared facilities span family recreation, fitness and rooftop leisure.

overview: The developer describes a 60-floor tower with 1,200 apartments and furnished interiors. Its page currently displays “Sold out”; this is not a live resale inventory check.
research.locationNote: Dubai Maritime City waterfront. Confirm the selected home’s orientation, view corridor and final surrounding development before purchase.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 1.3m at launch; the developer’s current page shows Sold out. No current direct-sale allocation or binding quote is confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The brochure says 70/30 at 1% monthly; the current page advertises 0.5%. A historical four-bedroom template totals 70% by completion and 30% afterward. Property Finder instead labels 20/50/30 with 30% on handover; Tanami shows 10/59/1/30. Confirm the selected option.
research.handoverNote: The developer states 2029; Property Finder says March 2029. The historical template prints December 2028 despite instalments through June 2029 and post-handover from July 2029. No completion is confirmed.
